scope: Final review group: routing/security/header consolidation, auth/recovery UI and routes, root error/focus/animation foundation, test dependency/lockfile changes and unused prototype removal
reviewExtent: Full current bodies read for auth components/routes/helpers/proxy/security; full base-to-current diff read for package/config/root/error/animation files; relevant CSS media rules and homepage semantic additions inspected. Unchanged root metadata and homepage markup not wholesale re-audited. Initial combined output truncated; auth bodies reread individually before recording this review.
invariants: Canonical legacy planner redirect retains destination/query; protected/auth redirects carry refreshed or cleared session cookies
Redirect targets accept internal relative paths and reject protocol-relative, backslash, scheme, control-character inputs
Central CSP matches former Next config; provider image domains remain limited; eval remains development-only
Tracing explicitly carries bundled OG font assets; Next database-isolation assertion preserved
Only instrumentation-client initializes browser Sentry; replay text/media masking and existing request-query stripping preserved
Shared auth action token prevents duplicate/mixed email/OAuth methods and late departure after unmount; bfcache pageshow resets abandoned pending action
Inputs stay disabled before hydration and while auth action pending; labels/autocomplete/status and48px primary controls retained
Sign-in accepts existing legacy passwords; signup requires8 characters and matching confirmation; email confirmation is not treated as signed-in session
Auth callbacks use request origin rather than untrusted forwarding headers; verified continuation and cancellation/timeout return to login
Password recovery preserves validated continuation; pending inputs frozen; timeout copy explicitly says outcome unconfirmed; success heading focuses
Root error remains independent of app CSS/router, uses real document home link and focused heading with responsive48px controls
Scroll reveal never hides SSR content; absent IntersectionObserver leaves content readable; reduced-motion CSS cancels looping/translating effects
Test-renderer additions are development-only; lockfile changes limited to required renderer/types and react-is resolution placements
Deleted agent/Anthropic wrapper have no source symbol/import consumers; active planning points at planTripWorkflow; historical docs describe deletion
limits: Hosted OAuth/SMTP/password mutation/session revocation and telemetry delivery remain external
